info.name: nodeskclaw-knowledge v2.4 — E2E & RAGFlow Verification
info.description: Current main-branch E2E collection. Full flow combines /api/v2 product/runtime APIs with /api/v1 compatibility APIs for SourceFile/Ingestion/RetrievalProfile. Use Backend login token as Bearer. For full v2.4 testing enable Build, Application, v2.3 Artifacts/Quality and v2.4 Release/Federation/Artifact ACL flags in the Knowledge container.

request.description: 200 才进入完整 E2E；503 先检查 database/ragflow/backend。

exec: const a = j.data && j.data.access_token, r = j.data && j.data.refresh_token;
if (a) { pm.collectionVariables.set('access_token', a); try { pm.environment.set('access_token', a); } catch(e) {} }
if (r) { pm.collectionVariables.set('refresh_token', r); try { pm.environment.set('refresh_token', r); } catch(e) {} }
try { pm.environment.set('member_id', j.data.member_id); pm.environment.set('org_id', j.data.org_id); } catch(e) {}
if (value) { pm.collectionVariables.set('kb_id', value); try { pm.environment.set('kb_id', value); } catch(e) {} }

item.name: 02 Source File & Ingestion — API v1 compatibility

formdata.description: 导入后手工选择本地 PDF/DOCX/MD/TXT

exec: const sf = j.data && j.data.source_file, fv = j.data && j.data.file_version_id, job = j.data && j.data.job;
if (sf && sf.id) { pm.collectionVariables.set('source_file_id', sf.id); try { pm.environment.set('source_file_id', sf.id); } catch(e) {} }
if (fv) { pm.collectionVariables.set('file_version_id', fv); try { pm.environment.set('file_version_id', fv); } catch(e) {} }
if (job && job.id) { pm.collectionVariables.set('ingestion_job_id', job.id); try { pm.environment.set('ingestion_job_id', job.id); } catch(e) {} }

if (pm.response.code===200) { const j=pm.response.json(); const jobs=(j.data&&j.data.jobs)||[]; if(jobs[0]) { pm.collectionVariables.set('build_job_id', jobs[0].id); try{pm.environment.set('build_job_id',jobs[0].id)}catch(e){} } }
if (value) { pm.collectionVariables.set('application_id', value); try { pm.environment.set('application_id', value); } catch(e) {} }
